relations: Vero 与 Vesper：互相看不惯却都为 Brawley 忍着，"It’s no secret we don’t like each other, but I put up with her because of Brawley and vice versa."
Vesper 与 Brawley：Vesper 敢推 Vero 下屋顶，因为"You wouldn’t hurt Brawley like that"、"He would mourn you and get over it."
Vero 与 Brawley：Vero 自称"I love him more than anything in this world"，两人以"Who do you belong to?"与"Stay with me"这类话确认彼此的归属与陪伴
Vesper 与 Karo："Vesper texted me,” Karo says."——是 Vesper 事先叫来垫子接住 Vero
Clay 与 Vero：楼下的质问与威胁关系，"“If you fall off that roof,” Clay says, “I will kill you myself.”"
numbers: two of the other guys from the circus
a thousand miles a minute for the last few days

facts.fact: Vero 坐在收容所屋顶边缘不下去，楼下是 Clay、Brawley、Ares 三个等着他下来的人。
facts.anchor: I sit on the edge of the roof and look down at the three waiting men below me.

facts.fact: Clay 在楼下冲他吼"现在就下来"，并威胁"你要是从那屋顶掉下去，我亲手杀了你"。
facts.anchor: “If you fall off that roof,” Clay says, “I will kill you myself.”

facts.fact: Ares 提醒 Vero：Kayla 也说过要他滚出她的生活，Vero 坚持这句话和她说过的"永不离开"并不矛盾。
facts.anchor: “She also told you to get out of her life,” Ares says.

facts.fact: Vesper 自行爬上屋顶，冲楼下三人喊"别惯着他！"并要 Vero 下来。
facts.anchor: “Stop babying him!” she yells, then looks at me. “Get down.”

facts.fact: Vesper 指出 Vero 毁了 Kayla 的工作、砸了场子、让她在所有人面前难堪，并说她的两句话都是真的、他不能只挑一句当真。
facts.anchor: But she also meant what she said at the bar. Both things can be true. You don’t get to pick one and ignore the other.

facts.fact: Vesper 一脚把 Vero 推下屋顶，Vero 落在 Karo 与两个马戏团小丑备好的垫子上；Karo 说人是 Vesper 发短信叫来的，"Everyone knew you weren’t coming down."
回到房间后 Brawley 不发怒而是显得疲惫，Vero 只能自己说出"Fine, you scared me"，Brawley 说今晚不谈修好，先回家。
facts.anchor: “You don’t tonight,” he says, moving his hand to the back of my neck and pulling me toward him. “Let’s go home for now.”

facts.fact: Brawley 命令 Vero 说"你是个坏孩子"，Vero 照说并主动认错；事后 Vero 提议给自己装微芯片让 Brawley 随时知道他在哪，被拒绝。
facts.anchor: “Microchip me,” I say, and his brow furrows.
